items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); personal articles, conveyance contents and property away from the insured location are excluded (4.3(d),(e),(f)). The identical Case 35 was not indemnified, so t = 0.
No insured event exists, and journey and conveyance charges are expressly not insured costs (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)), so t = 0.
